answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by anchoring each identity to a licensed natural-dye workshop: the holder tends one dye vat, fermenting juniper berries and mineral pigment into cloth a textile guild inspects each season. Random checks summon the holder to dye a swatch live on camera within hours, and no fable of a second vat survives inspection, since one dyer cannot tend two vats at once. The workshop fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real vat, another dyeing season, another human, and twice the prior fee.
